gp: 0xFEBFC000 (V850 global pointer; set in crt0 at 0x10C82: mov 0xFEBFC000,gp)
rev_cut_signal: 0xFEBF642E (gp-0x5BD2; RPM-domain, in the 0xFEBF6xxx sdata sensor block next to RPM 0xFEBF615E)

launch_control.summary: GSX-R1000 launch limits THROTTLE per gear (maps 0x174FB0-0x175020), not a fixed RPM hold.

sensor_block.0xFEBF6436: intake air pressure IAP / load (main load axis)

traction_control.summary: 10-level + Launch TC. FUN_00055016 switches on the TC level byte 0xFEBF6459 (gp-0x5ba7) to pick each level's Cut-vs-Slip Error/Rate/History maps, indexed by slip 0xFEBF6164.

auto_blip.summary: GSX-R1000 downshift/decel throttle opening (auto-blip) runs through the engine-brake ETV controller, not a separate QS-blip map.

power_mode.summary: SDMS (Suzuki Drive Mode Selector) power-mode level is byte 0xFEF0267D (0-10). A dedicated switch controller cluster (0x07BEF-0x07D9) reads/writes/latches it; FUN_00029198 reads it as the index into the 11-point mode-gain curve 0x1513B0 (ported axis label 'SDMS Field-3 Level (0-10)') and scales the ETV throttle/torque target (2D map 0x1511A8, 23x39, indexed by rider-demand fef00530 x engine RPM).
power_mode.note: Confirmed by the map's own ported axis breakpoints (0..10). This is the A/B/C-equivalent power-mode level on the GSX-R1000R M7; verify exact per-level gains on a bench.

cruise.summary: The M7 image contains Suzuki's speed-governor / cruise calibration and code (shared platform - the GSX-S1000/GT siblings use cruise; the GSX-R1000R has no cruise switch, so this is likely dormant but present). FUN_0002DA0E computes set-speed tracking from accel-rate-gain curve 0x150DAC and speed-correction-vs-set-speed table 0x150E5C (14 pts 30..240 km/h). FUN_0002E0AE and the state machine FUN_0002D95E manage the governor state (state byte fef005f8 values 0x0B/0x0E/0x11/0x12, mode gate fef00652).

functions.0x2da0e: set-speed tracking: curves 0x150DAC (accel rate gain), 0x150DC0, 0x150E5C (speed correction vs 30-240 km/h set speed), 0x150E70
functions.0x2d95e: governor state machine: state byte fef005f8, gate byte fef00652

cruise.note: Low confidence that this is active on the GSX-R1000R; labels are ported from the cruise-capable Hayabusa/GSX-S map set. Treat as 'speed-governor code present', not a confirmed working feature.

quickshifter_upshift.summary: Upshift ignition-cut, traced end to end. Dispatcher FUN_0002B720 runs the whole QS pipeline only while the master-enable byte 0x154DD2 == 0. Detection FUN_0002A96E arms the cut when the GP (gear-position) sensor (gp-0x5C86) crosses from the Window-B offset curve 0x1509A8 up to the Window-C curve 0x1509BC, with the shift signal fef02630 inside the valid window 0x1559BC..0x1559BA (x64) and gears 1-2 excluded; it sets the cut-state flags in 0xFEF005A3 (bit0 armed, bit2 cut-active) and calls the cut actuator FUN_00029F22. Phase sequencer FUN_0002A698 steps the cut through phases 1-4 in byte 0xFEF005F6, applying the 3-phase ignition-retard maps (0x15234C/0x1523BC/phase3 vs RPM x TP). Window target FUN_0002A652 builds the per-gear window threshold fef00570 from base febf5e78 + per-gear offset curve 0x15096C.
quickshifter_upshift.retard_maps: 0x15234C / 0x1523BC / phase3 (3-phase upshift ignition retard vs RPM x TP)
quickshifter_upshift.window_maps: 0x150944 (A) / 0x1509A8 (B) / 0x1509BC (C) GP-sensor upshift window offsets vs gear; 0x15096C per-gear window target
quickshifter_upshift.note: Mirror of the downshift auto-blip chain (3f) but for upshift: upshift cuts spark via retard, downshift opens the ETV via the engine-brake controller.

idle_control.summary: Idle air-control is the ECT-indexed Target/Airflow curve set (0x170558 base airflow, 0x170870/0x1708B0 target A/B, 0x1708F0.. ECT curves) driven by a feedback integrator. FUN_00053DC6 gates the correction on a mask of ready-flags (byte gp-0x5ED6); FUN_00053C0C runs the feedback step with debounce count 0x1702C1; FUN_00053F3E keeps a moving average of the slip/airflow signal febf6166 over a window of 0x1744AE samples; FUN_0004FF2E is the per-channel servo update.
idle_control.airflow_correction_enable: 0x1702C0 (==0x80 disables the idle airflow-correction block; stock 0xFF = active)
idle_control.ready_flags: byte at gp-0x5ED6 (idle ready/enable bit-mask), feedback state fef00f48/fef00f49
idle_control.note: Idle target itself is in the ported ECT curves; these scalars gate and tune the closed-loop correction.

fuel_inputs_note: Fuel map inputs traced from reader decompiles (docs/trace-fuel.c): gp-relative sensor reads in each a1fca/a201e/a2344 call. gp=0xFEBFC000 -> gp-0x5bc0=ECT, gp-0x5c3c=TP, gp-0x5c86=RPM, gp-0x5c40=TP2, gp-0x5bbe=gear, gp-0x5c0a=speed. Per-gear maps are pointer-table selected by the gear bitmask (gp-0x5bbe); their lookup axis is the gp-read sensor shown.
etv_pwr_note: ETV/cruise/anti-lift map inputs from reader decompiles (docs/trace-etv.c). ETV monitor air/torque = IAP(gp-0x5bca=0xFEBF6436) x RPM(gp-0x5c82=0xFEBF637E); ETV gain = RPM(gp-0x5c84=0xFEBF637C); cruise correction indexed by computed speed error (set - 0xFEBF5E86 actual); LF throttle-limit = derived demand 0xFEF02E2C x load 0xFEBF6169. The 42 'ETV - PWR/Slot' power-mode maps are pointer-table selected (table 0x192BC0/0x192BCC by SDMS mode 0xFEF0267D) with no directly decompilable reader - left unresolved.
power_mode_etv_note: ETV power-mode (PWR) and Slot target maps: selected from pointer table 0x192BA8[gear(fef02e51)*6 + mode(fef0267c)] by FUN_0008BE2C, then interpolated a201e(map, X=fef02e44, Y=fef02e46). FUN_0008BDC8 sets X=gp-0x5c52=0xFEBF63AE (rider throttle demand/APS) and Y=gp-0x5c84=0xFEBF637C (engine RPM). So all PWR/Slot maps share axes APS x RPM; gear+mode only pick which map. docs/trace-pwr.c.
ho2_note: HO2/O2 closed-loop inputs from docs/trace-ho2.c. Monitor baro 0xFEBF6394, IAT 0xFEBF6443, heater/enable ECT 0xFEBF6440; cyl-balance bias = per-cyl O2 0xFEBF65E6/E8/EA/EC x RPM; closed-loop zone maps (FUN_00049b6e a2344) = TP 0xFEBF63EC x RPM, pointer-table selected so axes fixed per call.

diagnostics.summary: The diagnostic MONITORS are real and traced: HO2/catalyst O2 monitor (FUN_00040BAC + FUN_0003F8B2), the ETV Level-2 torque/air safety monitor (FUN_0008AE3E/0008E3B8 with the 0x193xxx IAP x RPM estimate maps), the EVAP purge monitor, and the wheel/speed monitor - all gate on enable/threshold constants now named (0x155AB2, 0x155A62/64, 0x170216/18/1A, 0x192CEA/CEC) plus the monitor maps already carrying TRACED INPUTS.
diagnostics.mil_lamp: NOT individually decoded. The MIL / warning lamp is driven through the RH850 port I/O space (0xFFFF_xxxx register writes) by logic that aggregates the monitor-result flags; identifying the exact port bit requires the specific RH850 variant's port datasheet, which is not in hand, so no lamp bit is labelled (would be a guess).
diagnostics.can_meter_outputs: NOT individually decoded. The instrument-cluster/CAN frames (tach, temp, gear, warning lamps) are assembled in code and written to the RS-CAN peripheral (0xFFE6_xxxx / 0xFFC6_xxxx region); the only calibration here is the Meter Fuel Consumption RPM/IAT scaling (already in the XDF). Per-frame field decode needs the Suzuki CAN DBC, not in hand, so no CAN field is labelled.
diagnostics.note: Monitors = calibration (named). MIL lamp + CAN dash output = code/peripheral logic with no per-bit calibration; left unlabelled rather than guessed.

steering_damper.note: Electronic steering damper (ESD). Confirmed by decompile: controller FUN_000784dc reads rear-wheel speed 0xFEBF63F4, looks up one of three 16-pt curves by mode byte 0xFEBF6480, runs a modulation chain, scales to 0-500 and calls FUN_00024cb4 (PWM ch 0x500) -> T54 solenoid. Matches the known GSX-R speed-vs-modulation damper map (0-300 km/h, 20 km/h steps) and Woolich's "Disable Steering Damper".
steering_damper.output_compensation: 0x171760 (5-pt gain vs 0xFEBF643C; shared by controller FUN_00078308 and the solenoid diagnostic)

solenoid_diagnostic.note: ESD solenoid fault monitor: compares measured feedback 0xFEBF6422 against expected (threshold tables 0x155218/0x15522C scaled by the 0x171760 compensation gain) computed from the damper command 0xFEBF62BC; sets fault bits in fef009c9/fef009ca. Backs the solenoid DTC.
